$description: Maps catalog families (InstrumentSheetFamily) to the legacy mp3split timing JSON used to slice the per-preset chromatic-scale recording into per-note vstsample slots. Imported from casperaki2-engine-js/api/v1.0/services/data/vstPreviews/rppFiles/ — see docs/54l.

notes.basses: Imported verbatim from legacy vstSamples.controller.create switch (basses → bassNotes).
notes.keys: Imported verbatim (keys → pianoNotes). Also covered kickDrums/snareDrums in legacy but those families use the playsample mechanic in our pipeline, not vstsample.
notes.popStrings_orchestral_popBrass: Mapped to padAndSynthNotes by musical convention — sustained tonal instruments share the chromatic-scale rendering. Legacy switch is not explicit for these families; the canonical preset file durations match the padAndSynthNotes 81.6s timing (verified for popStrings/popLowStringsLegato/Basses Legato.mp3 = 82.65s).
notes.guitars: Imported verbatim (acousticGuitars/electricGuitars → guitarNotes). Note: this covers SINGLE-NOTE multisamples only. Guitar CHORDS are played from a separate chord-file pipeline (longChords/mediumChords/shortChords + GuitarChord positional MIDI) — deferred to Stage 2.
notes.vocals: Imported verbatim (mapped to laNaSingerNotes). Vocal rendering itself is deferred (post-port), so this entry is reference only until the vocal adapter ships.
notes.drumComponents: kickDrums / snareDrums / hiHatsClosed / hiHatsOpen / cymbals / toms / shakers / clapsSnaps / percussionBreaks / percussionLoops / percussionMisc / drumKits are intentionally absent — drum components are staged via playsample-<id> (one-shot triggers), not vstsample multisamples.
notes.fx: fx is intentionally absent — fx uses key/bpm whole-file variants handled by the asset-resolver (docs/53s).
